Dear [Admissions Committee/Recruiting Team],  

Stefan and I collaborate daily at Nexus Financial Solutions, where he leads product strategy for our B2B fintech platform. As a peer in a mid-sized FAANG team, I’ve observed his work firsthand across cross-functional initiatives.  

Stefan’s strength lies in balancing competing priorities while maintaining clarity. He recently spearheaded a competitive analysis that reshaped our product roadmap, identifying gaps in the market that directly influenced a 20% increase in user retention for a core feature. His ability to distill complex data into actionable insights is rare.  

A standout moment occurred when he coordinated a cross-team integration between our security and dev teams during a critical launch. By establishing clear ownership and daily syncs, he resolved blockers that would’ve delayed the release by weeks. His calm under pressure and knack for aligning stakeholders ensure projects stay on track.  

Stefan’s roadmap planning is equally impressive. He once prioritized a feature set that balanced short-term wins with long-term vision, resulting in a 35% faster time-to-market for our latest product. His stakeholder management is rooted in transparency—he regularly shares progress updates, even when outcomes are uncertain, which builds trust across teams.  

Beyond skills, Stefan’s dedication is unwavering. He’ll stay late to refine a wireframe or debug a workflow, always prioritizing the user’s needs. His work ethic and strategic mind make him a standout in any environment.  

Sincerely,  
[Your Name]
